scoring.note: RMSE/MAE for the leaderboard use the leads every method has, so the hourly CNN-LSTM is not scored on different points than the 6-hourly models. Each method's native-grid score is also given.

truth.source: raw 15-min HOBO archive, resampled to the hour (+/-30 min, no interpolation)
truth.time_note: Archive clock is local standard time (UTC-5, no DST); shifted to UTC.

methods.label: U-Net
methods.blurb: Residual U-Net post-processing a GFS 0.25 deg grid, bilinear to the station.

provenance.input: GFS 0.25deg t2m/u10/v10 over the southern Ontario box, AWS noaa-gfs-bdp-pds byte-range GRIB
provenance.correction: corrected = GFS - predicted_residual, bilinear to station

methods.label: LSTM
methods.blurb: Per-lead LSTM correcting ECMWF AIFS bias from a sliding window of past errors.

provenance.note: One trained model per lead; leads without a checkpoint are null.

methods.label: CNN-LSTM
methods.blurb: CNN-LSTM reading a 30x30 HRRR crop and predicting per-lead station bias.

provenance.input: HRRR 3km t2m/u10/v10, 30x30 crop centred on the station, native units
provenance.correction: corrected = HRRR - predicted_bias (target is forecast - observation)

methods.label: ECMWF AIFS
methods.blurb: ECMWF AIFS as issued, no correction.

provenance.reconstruction: value = obs_6h(valid_time) + bias(lead); benchmark files store error, not forecast value

methods.label: GFS
methods.blurb: NOAA GFS as issued, no correction.

provenance.reconstruction: value = obs_6h(valid_time) + bias(lead); benchmark files store error, not forecast value

methods.label: HRRR
methods.blurb: NOAA HRRR interpolated to the station, no correction.

provenance.reconstruction: value = obs_6h(valid_time) + bias(lead); benchmark files store error, not forecast value
